title: Glowing orb UFOs at Pyramid Kuromanta shown in old paintings
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of Glowing orb UFOs at Pyramid Kuromanta shown in old paintings, about historical to present at Japan (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There is a phenomenon that occurs at Pyramid Coramanta that's been shown in ancient paintings of these glowing balls

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who studies pyramids, talks about Kuromanta, a hill in Akita, Japan that some call a pyramid. He says glowing balls of light appear there, and that old Japanese paintings show these same glowing balls, which if true would mean the lights have been seen at the site for centuries.
